translations./garage/brief: RO-2 uses Ackermann steering: it steers its front wheels but cannot spin in place. Send it to the calibration pad and observe its turning geometry.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. The minimum turning radius is fixed; watch where the run loses time.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Turn too late and the chassis must follow a wide arc. Inspect the path through the corner.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: If LiDAR sees the obstacle too late, even strong brakes cannot recover the lost distance. Note the first detection time.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-2: Steering system online. Planning a wide-radius turn.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-2 reached the calibration pad by turning early and respecting its steering geometry.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find the missing badge. An Ackermann chassis punishes a turn that begins too late.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
